name: agents-trust
description: Find APIs and inspect endpoint evidence. Quote-only by default.

AGENTS_TRUST_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.title: Optional Base wallet private key
AGENTS_TRUST_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional. Supply through secure host configuration; never put a key in chat or source control.

AGENTS_TRUST_ENABLE_PAYMENTS.title: Owner grant for one authorization
AGENTS_TRUST_ENABLE_PAYMENTS.description: Exact true allows one authorization per process, even if it fails. No per-call confirmation. Restart resets the grant.
